%normal! @b
%normal! @c

EOF
cp s.csv s2.csv && vim -Nu NONE -n -Es s2.csv -S t.vim; echo "exit=$?"; cat -A s2.csv; echo "---diff---"; diff s2.csv se.csv && echo MATCH
